before.rationale: Calls _confined_stat exactly once per scanned entry and builds each row's path from the parent prefix plus the entry name, so the walk loop adds no path resolution of its own and each listed note costs one followed stat.

after.rationale: Calls _confined_stat exactly once per scanned entry and builds each row's path from the parent prefix plus the entry name, so the walk loop adds no path resolution of its own and each listed note costs one followed stat.

before.rationale: Decides confinement per entry: only an entry that is a symlink is resolved and checked with path_is_relative_to against the resolved root, and every other entry returns its one cached DirEntry stat. This is where the three per-entry realpath calls were removed, so resolution is paid only for symlinks.
